---
name: Customer Satisfaction
description: "Collect customer satisfaction feedback at end of conversation."
routing:
  engine_managed: true
---

:::ordered_block id=main
name: default_customer_satisfaction
steps:
  - id: ask_csat
    collect: csat_score
    utterance: utter_ask_csat_score
    description: "How satisfied was the user (1–5)?"
  - id: thank_you
    action: utter_thank_you_for_feedback
:::
